design: decode_l0 --prefill-chunks N (M via CHUNK_M, inputs via CHUNK64MC_HOST_IN): 8 new chunk modules appended (existing enum indices untouched), per-chunk 64-layer record against SHARED payArena/scArena (weights loaded once) + decode-layout KV/SSM + preloaded norms, stream record+exec+destroy, D2D last row to dX, impP set -> existing loop seam (tail-only start, question, generate).
